transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net technical support, this is Kyle. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. Okay, so, I moved into a new place on Saturday and the internet still isn't working. The modem's been blinking orange for four days. I set it up myself with the kit you sent and it just won't connect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Which light is blinking orange?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The one with the little globe on it. The power light is fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Is the cable from the wall screwed into the back of the modem?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. That was the first thing I checked.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And is it going into the wall socket marked TV or the one marked data?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's only one socket in the living room. I don't think it says anything on it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Can you unplug the power from the modem, wait thirty seconds, and plug it back in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I've done that probably ten times. Look, this is the third time I've called this week. The first person told me to restart it, and the second one told me to wait twenty-four hours because the activation takes time. It's been four days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Can you do it one more time for me? Just so I can see it come up on my side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Fine. Okay, it's unplugged.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's back in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What is the globe light doing now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Same thing. Blinking orange.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And is there any other cable on the socket, like a splitter or a second box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No. It's just the one cable from the wall to the modem.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, give me a sec.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah, I'm here. Is the modem in the same room as the socket, or are you using an extension cable?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Same room. It's right next to the socket. The cable is the one that came in the box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Has it ever been solid white since you moved, even for a minute?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No. Never. Not once.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And at your old place, was it the same modem, or did we send you a new one for the new address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Same modem. I brought it with me. When I booked the move online it said to bring the equipment.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's useful. Oh, I should have pulled up your account first. Can I get the account number and the PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And can you confirm the new address for me?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: 42 Fenwick Road, flat 3.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Renee, that matches. Okay, let me take a look at the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Honestly this whole thing has been a nightmare. I work from home, I've been using my phone's data for four days and it's run out, and I've had to go and sit in a coffee shop to do my job. And this stupid modem just keeps blinking at me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. I'm looking at the move order now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Right.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so I can see the problem. The move order was created, but the activation for the new address is still showing as pending, and the modem is still registered to your old address. So the network at the new address doesn't recognise it, which is why the light keeps blinking.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So it's nothing to do with the modem? I've been unplugging it for four days for nothing?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The modem looks fine. It's the activation that didn't go through.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why did nobody see that the first two times I called?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can't see what they checked. It's showing as pending, which normally clears by itself, so they might have thought it just needed time.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's been four days.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah. It usually goes through within a few hours. Normally the provisioning team picks these up, but I can push it through from here, so I'm going to do that now rather than wait for them.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Thank you. Please do.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm moving the modem's registration over to the new address and resending the activation. It might take a couple of minutes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I've sent it. Can you watch the globe light and tell me what it does? It should go through a few colours and then settle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's still blinking orange.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Sometimes it needs a restart to pick up the new activation. Can you unplug it again and plug it back in? It takes about a minute to come back up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Unplugging it. Again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's back in.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It'll take a minute to come up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still orange.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Let me check the order. It looks like the activation failed because the old address was still attached to the modem. I need to remove the old address first and then send it again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Removing the old address now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, that's removed. Sending the activation again now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, it's gone through this time, it says active on my side. What's the light doing?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's blinking white now. That's new.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's good, that means it's found the network and it's setting up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Now it's... it's solid white. Oh my god, it's solid white.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, great. I can see the modem online on my side.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Finally. Can I test it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Can you connect your laptop to the WiFi and open a web page?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's loading. The WiFi name is the same as at my old place, so the laptop just connected by itself.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the modem keeps the same WiFi name and password. What plan were you expecting at the new address, the 200 or the 500?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The 200, I think. I didn't change the plan when I moved.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, yes, it's the 200. Can you run a speed test?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 208 down and 19 up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's right for your plan. The speed test is good.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Good. Is it going to stay working, or is it going to drop off again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It should stay working now. The problem was the activation, and that's done. The modem is registered to the new address now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. What about the four days I couldn't use it? I'm paying for this.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can put a credit on the account for the days it wasn't working. That would be four days at your plan price, so it'll come off your next bill.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. That's fair. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm adding that now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yeah, sorry, still here. That's done. It'll show on your next bill as a service credit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: While I have you, there's one more thing I want to check. When the move order was made, did you want to keep the landline number from your old address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I don't use the landline, I never did. I've only got the internet.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, then that's fine. I can see the landline was removed from the account when the move was booked, so you won't be charged for it.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And are all your devices connecting, your phone and anything else?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, my phone just connected too.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Can you try something that uses more data, like a video, just to make sure it's stable?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, a video's playing fine.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually, while I've got you, the WiFi in the bedroom is really weak. It's at the other end of the flat. Out here in the living room it's fine, but in there it's one bar and things load really slowly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. How far is the bedroom from the modem, roughly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Maybe ten metres? It's down the hallway, through two doors. And there's a bathroom in between.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Bathrooms are usually bad for WiFi because of the tiles and the pipes. Where exactly is the modem sitting at the moment?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: On the floor next to the socket, behind the sofa.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Being on the floor behind the sofa will cut down the signal quite a bit. Is there any way to get it up higher, like on a shelf or a table near the socket?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: There's a sideboard right next to it. I could put it on that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Try that, it should help a bit. Can you go into the bedroom and do a speed test, so we know what it's like now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I'm in the bedroom. It says 38 down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. And now can you go put the modem on the sideboard and test again in the bedroom? It doesn't need to restart, you can just move it, as long as the cables reach.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's on the sideboard. Back in the bedroom now. It says 64 down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so that's better. For full speed in the bedroom you'd probably need a mesh satellite. We have one that sits halfway down the hallway. It's five a month, or you can buy it outright.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How much is it to buy?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It's seventy-nine to buy outright.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'll think about it. I've spent enough on this move already. Sixty is okay for now, I mostly just sleep in there.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. If you change your mind you can order it in the app.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. I'll leave a note on the account explaining that the activation got stuck, in case anything else comes up with the move.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. And if it does go off again, what do I do?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If the globe light starts blinking orange again, call us and quote the note on the account, and they'll be able to see what we did today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else you need help with?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Actually, yes. Is there a way to get a static IP address on my plan? I need it for my work VPN sometimes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: A static IP is only on the business plans, I'm afraid. On a home plan the address can change, but it doesn't change very often, usually only when the modem restarts.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. My work might need it. Can I upgrade later if I have to?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, you can switch to a business plan at any time. The business team can go through the options with you. I can transfer you to them now if you want.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Not right now. I need to check with my office first.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. You can call the same number and choose the business option. So everything's working now with the internet?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, great, so that's resolved. The modem is active at the new address, the speed is right, and the credit is on the account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Renee. Please stay on the line after the call for a short survey. Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a good day.
